title: CitationTraverseInput
description: Input parameters for the ASTA-native, sentence-gated citation-traverse subagent (issue #14).

query.description: Retrieval query, e.g. '{label} / {resolved_name} in {scope} {tissue}: location, structure, function, markers'.

depth.description: Fixed number of hops to follow (0 = seed only). Dynamic-to-evidence depth is out of scope.

k_per_paper.description: Breadth cap: max surviving edges followed per paper per hop (safety budget for hub papers, not the relevance filter).

run_cap.description: Max distinct papers searched across the whole run.

score_threshold.description: Optional coarse snippet-score floor applied before the sentence-level gate.
